name: s2j-alliance-manager
description: Manage linked banners (including logos and videos) for partner companies in alliance relationships and display them in blocks on the front page and other locations.
author: Koutarou ISHIKAWA

scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:scss
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:ts:fix && npm run lint:scss:fix
scripts.build:dev: FLUSH_DIST=true npm run build:dev:admin && npm run build:dev:gutenberg && npm run build:dev:classic && npm run build:dev:frontend
scripts.build:dev:admin: NODE_ENV=development FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode development
scripts.build:dev:gutenberg: NODE_ENV=development FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode development
scripts.build:dev:classic: NODE_ENV=development FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode development
scripts.build:dev:frontend: NODE_ENV=development FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode development
scripts.build:production: FLUSH_DIST=true npm run build:production:admin && npm run build:production:gutenberg && npm run build:production:classic && npm run build:production:frontend
scripts.build:production:admin: NODE_ENV=production FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode production
scripts.build:production:gutenberg: NODE_ENV=production FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode production
scripts.build:production:classic: NODE_ENV=production FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode production
scripts.build:production:frontend: NODE_ENV=production FLUSH_DIST=false VITE_LOG_LEVEL=error vite build --mode production
scripts.dist: npm run dist:build && npm run dist:zip
